title: Nutty Aerated Jamaican Feta Cheese Hash
description: A nourishing, energizing breakfast dish featuring cubed feta cheese emulsified with mantecare, showcasing a delightful balance of spicy and nutty flavors.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine mantecare, peanuts, and crushed red pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add the cubed feta cheese to the blender and blend until the mixture is evenly distributed.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in crushed thyme, crushed garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Garnish the dish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve the Jamaican Feta Cheese Hash hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
To make the hash more aerated, gently fold in some air using a spatula or whisk before serving.
If desired, top the hash with some additional peanuts or seeds for added crunch.
